benefits.everydayDesc1: No battery in the tag. No tracking.
benefits.privacyDesc: Your phone number and email never appear on the tag. Reuniting happens through a private conversation inside the app.
benefits.privacyFoot: LESS EXPOSURE. MORE PEACE OF MIND.

dialog.desc: SeekerTag is in development for Android, with a focus on Solana Seeker. The public download is not available yet.

faq.a1: SeekerTag is an Android app focused on Solana Seeker. You can also use it on other compatible Android devices. For NFC, your device needs to support that technology.
faq.a2: Yes. Scanning the tag and chatting happen in the SeekerTag app for Android. The finder does not need an account to notify the owner.
faq.a3: No. QR and NFC tags are passive: they have no GPS or battery. They let someone who found your item contact you through the app.
faq.a4: Register an object in the app to generate its QR. You can share or print the PDF and attach the tag to the object. You can also write a compatible NFC tag with your phone.
faq.a5: No. Access to conversations is restricted by the app, but messages are not end-to-end encrypted. Your phone number and email are never shown to the finder.

meta.description: Turn your belongings into reunions. QR and NFC tags, private chat and a more human way to recover what matters. Built for Android and Solana Seeker.
meta.ogDescription: One small tag. A new chance to come back. Meet SeekerTag for Android and Solana Seeker.
meta.title: SeekerTag What is yours finds its way back.

steps.s1d: Add your object in the app. Print a QR code or write an NFC tag and carry that connection with you.
steps.s2d: The finder scans the tag with SeekerTag and sends a message. No account or contact details required.
steps.s3d: Talk in the app, arrange the handoff and confirm the return. What is yours becomes part of your story again.
